g.text: Exploratory selected grid · 15 complete family × task paths: 5 rise · 9 mixed · 1 falls
Result: point-estimate direction changes by task and family. A larger tier can move upward on one task and downward on another.
Accuracy panels share one scale; METEOR is separate. No intervals are saved; Qwen/Llama tiers also differ in period. ValuePrism predicts synthetic/GPT-4 labels.
